thread:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — product has greenlit the Kestrel pilot. We need a cross-cloud org/project/account bootstrap checklist + quota requests for GPUs and networking. Goal: infra ready in 7 business days.

Jorge Alvarez: +1. Target regions: us-west-2, europe-west1, ap-southeast-1. Primary concern is GPU availability in eu-west1 for A100s.

Lin Nguyen: Can we list exact quota items we'll request? I'll open support cases in parallel. Off the top of my head: EC2 GPU family (p4d, g5, a100), ENI / ENI per instance / vCPU soft limits, GCP GPUs per region and per project, Azure NC/ND series. Also subnet IP limits and egress quotas.

Ravi Patel: Add private networking: Transit Gateway attachments for AWS, VNET peering for Azure, Shared VPC for GCP. We need centralized flow logs to observability account and an S3/GCS archive with lifecycle.

Maya Chen: Good. I'll drive the AWS requests. Lin — can you take GCP? Jorge — Azure? Assign owners inline so we don't double-request.

Lin Nguyen: Taking GCP. I'll raise quota requests for: "GPUS (all regions)" -> A100 / T4 counts, "Compute Engine API" enablement, regional static IPs, VPC peering quota, and project-level service account quota. Also will create a folder under org-policy with tag inheritance: team:kestrel, env:pilot, cost-center:ai-pilots.

Jorge Alvarez: I'll do Azure. Will open a support ticket for NC/ND series quota increases in westeurope and southeastasia. Also request vCPU hard quota bump and accelerated networking NIC limits.

Ravi Patel: AWS checklist (short):
- Create org unit kestrel-pilot, enable SCP that restricts IAM changes except by infra-admins.
- Request service limits: p4d (pod-based), g5, a1/gpu-instance families in us-west-2 + eu-west-1.
- Raise ENI limit to 10000 and private IPv4 per subnet to 250 (for large node pools).
- Request ELB quota increases (NLB/ALB) and ALB target group limits.
- Enable consolidated billing and attach cost allocation tags: team, env, cost-center, project.

Maya Chen: Add security/best-practices: KMS keys in each region, CMKs with key rotation enabled, and a central HSM plan for any PII. Also ensure audit logs export to central logging project/account with retention 1y.

Lin Nguyen: For GCP specifics, note that GPUs require quotas per region+zone and per GPU type. I'll include this snippet in the support case: \n```
Project: projects/kestrel-pilot-001
Quota changes requested:\n  - "A100 GPUs (nvidia.com/gpu-a100)": +8 in europe-west1
  - "T4 GPUs": +16 in asia-southeast1
  - "Static External IPs": +50 in us-west1
  - "VPC network peering connections": +10
```
Also enabling Organization Policy: restrictPublicBuckets = true and enforce labels on resource creation.

Jorge Alvarez: Azure ticket notes: Subscription: 7a3f-xxxx, request NCv3/NDv2 series quota increase by sku and region. Add Application Insights ingestion quota for pilot telemetry.

Maya Chen: Cost question — pilot expected steady-state: 2 p4d nodes + burst of 4 a100s across regions. Estimate monthly spend: approx $60k if on-demand. Options: request convertible reserved capacity or spot for batch jobs. Thoughts?

Ravi Patel: For pilot I'd recommend mix: reserved for baseline (2 p4ds) and spot for bursts (a100). Also enable cost alerts on the org billing account: threshold at 25% of forecast to Slack #billing-alerts. Tag enforcement + nightly job to surface unlabeled resources.

infra-bot: Deploy checklist created: https://infra.internal/playbooks/kestrel-crosscloud-bootstrap (permission: infra-eng). Steps 1..10 added and owners populated.

Maya Chen: Next actions:
- Jorge: open Azure request (owner) - due EOD tomorrow
- Lin: GCP quota cases + labels/policy - due EOD tomorrow
- Ravi: AWS quota cases + org SCP + cost alerts - due EOD tomorrow
- Maya: security/KMS/HSM coordination with security team - due in 2 days

Jorge Alvarez: Acknowledged. I'll paste ticket IDs here when created.

Lin Nguyen: Filed GCP case 22010234 — requested A100 + T4 quotas. ETA from Google support: 48-72h.

Ravi Patel: AWS case opened #1234567890 — requested p4d and ENI increases. Also started limit increase for ALB/NLB. ETA 24-48h.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Keep updates brief here and drop final checklist link when all quotas approved. :thumbsup:
